newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ica upped to buy from hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ica upped to buy from hold.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell raised Mexican construction firm Empresas Ica to buy from hold, estimating earnings per share at 4.78 pesos in 1997 and 5.0 pesos in 1988.
-- "We believe the company is very well positioned to take advantage of the increase in projects for (state oil firm) Pemex and the Federal Electricity Commission," said Gordon Lee, a DMG analyst.
-- He said Ica has lagged its main rival Bufete Industrial, which suggests its stock price has room to grow. It also stands to gain from potential toll road debt restructurings, he said.
